watch.text: Forwards William Eklund (ankle), Warren Foegele (knee) and Andre Burakovsky (lower body) are out vs Calgary; Hayden Hodgson (groin) is day-to-day.
Starting goalie not confirmed before the morning skate: Linus Ullmark (11-1-0, 4 of the last 6 starts) projected, Samuel Ersson the alternative.
D Kevin Bahl is out for the season (Achilles surgery) and Jonathan Huberdeau (hip) is out; Martin Pospisil (upper body) is day-to-day after a hit from Chicago's Wyatt Kaiser.
LW Artemi Panarin (personal, missed 4 games) and D Erik Gustafsson (upper body) are day-to-day and expected back Monday at Montreal; not confirmed.
Dylan Guenther (IR since Nov 11, 2-4 weeks) and D John Marino (15 games missed) are nearing returns from upper-body injuries; not confirmed for Winnipeg.
Clayton Keller (illness) missed Saturday vs Anaheim and is day-to-day for Monday.
Toronto has the most players on IR in the league and has lost 9 of 10; Kirill Marchenko (out since Oct 26) and Colton Sissons skated in non-contact jerseys Sunday; Jack Roslovic is day-to-day.
D Alexander Romanov is out with a torn ACL; D Ryan Pulock (lower body) is day-to-day.
Mathew Barzal returned Nov 14 after missing the start of the season.
C Sean Monahan (did not travel, projected back Nov 25) and Conor Garland (IR) are out with upper-body injuries.
Out: Anthony Mantha (throat fracture surgery), D Johnathan Kovacevic (high ankle sprain, 4-6 weeks from Nov 17) and D Seamus Casey (knee).

401892775.summary: Ottawa is missing three forwards (Eklund, Foegele, Burakovsky) and hasn't confirmed its goalie, which covers some of why the market is lower on the Senators than we are.

reasons.text: Senators forwards William Eklund, Warren Foegele and Andre Burakovsky are out.
Ottawa's starter (Ullmark projected, Ersson possible) is unconfirmed before the morning skate.
Against that, Calgary is without Kevin Bahl (season) and Jonathan Huberdeau.
